_comment: Collections referenced in src/ that intentionally have NO firestore.rules match block. check-rules-coverage.cjs skips these. The default expectation is that a client-referenced collection HAS a module-aware rules block, so this list should stay SHORT; any entry must fall into one of the documented buckets below and carry a justification. Written 2026-10-25 when the gate was ported from DawinOS: every live ZeusOS collection it found (engine_config, users/*/settings, the intelligence* feeds, HR performance_*, feedback, contract_amendments, contracts/*/audit, auditLog, ai_feedback, the companies/* finance + strategy subcollections, the time_entries collection group) got a real match block in the same PR; only code that is not reachable from a routed page is listed here.

_buckets.id-generation-idiom: `doc(collection(db,'x')).id` only mints a random ID — never reads/writes the collection. The script detects and skips this idiom automatically, so no allowlist entry is needed.
_buckets.extension-or-admin-sdk: Written only by a Firebase Extension or a Cloud Function via the Admin SDK, which bypasses rules; clients never read/write directly. An entry here must name the writer.
_buckets.dead-scaffolding: DawinOS code that survives in the fork but belongs to a module ZeusOS removed in Phase 1 (the v6 compatibility API, the Firestore migration runner, design-manager and MES paths). Writing a match block would open data for a feature that does not exist. The right fix is to DELETE the code and the entry together; until then the collection stays denied.
_buckets.unreferenced-scaffolding: A service or hook references the collection, but no routed page imports it (checked 2026-10-25 against src/router/index.tsx: the hr-central organization / skills / succession trees, contract templates, the strategy aggregation + snapshot services and the legacy useSettings hook are exported from their module barrels and consumed by nothing that mounts). The access site cannot execute in a browser, so a match block would open data for a feature that does not exist. WHEN YOU WIRE THE FEATURE: remove the entry and add a real module-aware match block; the gate will fail until you do, which is the point.
_buckets.test-harness: src/testing seeders and runners — never bundled into the app; they run against the emulator with their own credentials.
_buckets.known-denied: LIVE code that reaches a path no rule covers, where the owner decided (or a follow-up must decide) to leave it refused rather than add a block. Every entry is FILE-scoped (allowSites) and carries a note naming the caller and why it stays denied. This is a backlog, not a pass: fix the caller and delete the entry.

_allowSites_note: allowSites silences ONLY the listed files' access sites for a key, so a new caller of the same path still fails the gate. Keys are leaf collection paths with ids as * (companies/*/departments), **/name for a collection group, `invalid fn(path)` for a wrong-parity path. The checker warns about entries that no longer suppress anything — delete them when it does.

deprecationLogs.note: DawinOS v6 compatibility API middleware; nothing in ZeusOS mounts src/api/compatibility.

engagements.note: DawinOS advisory engagements through the v6 compatibility adapters and the migration runner; advisory was removed in PR #20.

v6_payments.note: DawinOS v6 compatibility API; not mounted in ZeusOS.

v6_projects.note: DawinOS v6 compatibility API and migration runner; not mounted in ZeusOS.

migrationBackups.note: DawinOS Firestore migration runner (src/migration); never run from the ZeusOS app.

migrationJobs.note: DawinOS Firestore migration runner (src/migration); never run from the ZeusOS app.

designProjects/*/designItems/*/deliverab.note: The shared file manager still carries the design-manager deliverables path; the designProjects rules were removed with the module in Phase 1. Delete the branch when the file manager is next touched.

manufacturingOrders.note: kpiAutoMeasurement still has a manufacturing-orders KPI source from DawinOS; the MES was removed in Phase 1. Replace with an agency KPI source (stream K of the port map) and delete this entry.

analytics_events.note: core/services/analyticsService has no importer at all; product analytics go through src/shared/services/firebase/analytics.ts (GA4).

userSettings.note: Legacy JS hook re-exported from core/settings; nothing calls useSettings(). Preferences live at users/{uid}/settings/preferences (ruled).

contract_templates.note: contract-template.service is exported from the hr-central barrel; no routed page imports it.

companies/*/employees.note: hr-central/organization (departments, positions, reporting lines) is not what /hr/org-structure renders (src/pages/hr/OrgStructurePage.tsx imports none of it). The staff file stays closed until the feature is wired.

companies/*/development_plans.note: hr-central/succession — the routed /hr/performance/development-plans page uses performanceService, not this.

companies/*/departments.note: strategy aggregation + snapshot services; their hooks (usePerformanceAggregation/Trends/Snapshot) are consumed by no routed page — the live strategy pages read okr_objectives / kpi_definitions (ruled).

companies/*/subsidiaries.note: strategy aggregation + snapshot services — see companies/*/departments.

certifications.note: hr-central/skills — useSkills is consumed by no routed page (the /hr/performance pages use performanceService).

kpis.note: Seeded by the emulator test harness only.

okrs.note: Seeded by the emulator test harness only.
